stories.headline: US imposes visa restrictions on Chilean officials over China submarine cable project
stories.summary: The US State Department revoked visas for three Chilean government officials, including Transport Minister Juan Carlos Muñoz, citing their involvement in a telecommunications project that 'undermines regional security.' The action relates to a planned submarine cable connecting Chile directly to China/Hong Kong, which Washington views as a security risk.

stories.headline: Chinese embassy accuses US of violating Chilean sovereignty over submarine cable sanctions
stories.summary: China's embassy in Chile issued a strong statement condemning US visa restrictions on Chilean officials, defending the Chile-China submarine cable project as legitimate cooperation and accusing Washington of 'hegemonic and despotic' behavior in trying to interfere with bilateral projects.

stories.headline: Presidential transition preparations as Kast readies to take office from Boric

stories.headline: Codelco dismisses executives and faces criminal investigation over El Teniente mine concealment
stories.summary: State copper miner Codelco fired three senior executives after an internal audit found they concealed technical information about a 2023 rock explosion at El Teniente mine from regulators. Prosecutors raided executive homes and corporate offices as part of a criminal investigation into the cover-up, which may be linked to the 2025 mine accident that killed six workers.

stories.headline: Boric faces protests during final presidential trip to Easter Island
stories.summary: President Boric conducted his final regional trip to Rapa Nui (Easter Island) with just weeks left in office, receiving mixed reception including protests and criticism from locals who accused him of only visiting when leaving office. The trip was defended by government as ongoing work until the last day.

stories.headline: Armed forces reforms and equipment acquisitions announced
stories.summary: Chile announced new drone acquisition programs with plans to manufacture 112 drones in 18 months as part of defense technology sovereignty goals. Spanish company Skyboria presented dual-use UAV capabilities to Chilean forces. New defense funding regulations were also published for strategic capabilities financing.

stories.headline: President Boric receives performance bonus amid final weeks in office
stories.summary: President Boric received a performance bonus that increased his salary from $7 million to $10 million pesos between November and December 2025, based on meeting government targets under the Management Improvement Program that applies to all public servants.

articles.title: Presidente Boric recibió bono por cumplimiento de metas que incrementó en $3 millones su sueldo

stories.headline: Boric appeals to Vatican for humanitarian approach on Cuba crisis
stories.summary: President Boric wrote to Pope Leo XIV urging a humanitarian focus amid Cuba's ongoing crisis, expressing Chile's concern about living conditions on the island. The letter was sent as Chile provided $1 million in humanitarian aid to Cuba through the Chile Fund against Hunger and Poverty.

articles.title: Chilean President Boric Appeals to the Vatican: Urges Humanitarian Focus in Cuba Amid Crisis
